2117636799405134284.en_summary: @Cointelegraph reports Justin Sun moved to sanction World Liberty Financial for late UAE citizenship disclosure in his $WLFI suit; after listing only Florida then 22 members across Florida, Delaware, Puerto Rico and UAE, WLFI argues no federal jurisdiction. Sun invested $45M, sued in April, and plans to re-file in California state court. Images attached. (Reposted by @justinsuntron)
2117636799405134284.zh_summary: @Cointelegraph 報道 Justin Sun 申請制裁 World Liberty Financial，指其在 $WLFI 訴訟中遲披露阿聯酋公民身分；先僅列佛羅里達，後改列跨佛羅里達、特拉華、波多黎各與阿聯酋的 22 名成員並主張無聯邦管轄。Sun 投資 4500 萬美元，4 月提告，計劃改在加州州法院重提。附圖。（由 @justinsuntron 轉發）
